subject: Integration suite ready for root review; 2 bridge gaps, ABI/producer/job pass
body:
Status integration_tests. New owned test: gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py, plus worker helpers abi_oracle.py, tgp2_contract_test.c, n2mb_v2_job_test.c, producer_plan_test.py, STATUS.md under workers/integration_tests. Production read-only, no commit/device/native build.

Run from work/: python3 gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py. Latest (source hashes in STATUS): ABI PASS resource160/descriptor64/region1172/v2 11496; TGP2 156 checks 0 fail; n2mb selector7 fake-JM 76 checks with 2 required failures; ASan/UBSan TGP2 pass, job same 2 semantic failures no sanitizer finding; real Rust planner 38/38 on test_fast_math.air and accumulate_kernel.air.

Passing coverage: generated C/Rust sizeof+offsetof (catches the earlier missing region flags/view_format_vk class of mismatch), complete COMPUTE_JOB byte-equality to v1 emitters, SHADER_PROGRAM codeVA/preload/register allocation, LOCAL_STORAGE, FAU Metal30->native-buffer slot1, SRT table1[N]/table2[N] address+size, combined native binding5 vs Metal9, imported IOSurface plane address, storage image table1[4], read-only image write-mask, dummy table2[256] 257-entry table, write masks/retained handles/code bytes, v1 byte regression, multi-level explicit refusal, null/bad-span/offset/missing-descriptor/undeclared-binding/unknown-token/atomic-only refusals with unchanged outputs, and real planner descriptor/native-binding/region/specialization/refusal checks.

Ready-for-review blockers (owner compute, detailed repros in previous message 1792944250323360290): (1) combined descriptor sampler_index=99 accepted; (2) nonzero wire swizzle silently replaced by identity because swizzle_valid is never set. Both are gated as required failures, not skipped. Everything else in this scoped suite is green. Unresolved broader gates remain explicit: no tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 symbol yet (real compiler cannot emit TGP2), transport level0-only, view_level/layer informational, frontend object-lifetime not covered here, no GPU/pixel/IOSurface-coherence claim.

frontend_audit: please review the ABI oracle method (parses Rust repr(C) and generates C probe; no handwritten sizes) and the assertion scope. Root: suite is stable enough to integrate; it currently fails only on the two bridge semantics above. I will re-run after compute changes and post updated result. No phone/build/publish.
